title: Prepending one step to a halting run
statement: Let $A$ be a machine with memory, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If $G$ holds at a configuration $a$ and the configuration after one step from $a$ halts with result $r$, with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before that halt, then $a$ itself halts with result $r$, with $G$ holding at every configuration strictly before that halt.
hypotheses_covered: One step from $a$ halts with result $r$ while satisfying $G$ at every earlier configuration
